skill.name: ppt-editing-skill
skill.description: Edit existing PowerPoint files or templates with XML-safe workflows for slide mapping, XML text updates, cleanup, and validated PPTX repacking.
skill.summary: Guide XML-safe editing of existing PowerPoint templates and repack the finished PPTX.
skill.author: MiniMax-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code, or XML examples in SKILL.md. I confirmed one medium issue: the workflow tells users to stage output in /tmp without secure temporary file guidance. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or malicious instructions were found.

remediation.suggestion: Use a unique per-run temporary directory, restrict permissions, and validate final output paths before copying from /tmp.

remediation.issue: Shell examples lack path quoting guidance
remediation.suggestion: Show quoted paths or argument-array execution for cp and markitdown commands that handle user-provided filenames.

remediation.issue: Referenced helper scripts are not included
remediation.suggestion: Publish the helper scripts or state where they come from, and document their archive extraction safeguards.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint template edits can break layouts, relationships, and XML formatting. This skill gives a structured workflow for safe PPTX updates, cleanup, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides copying a user PPTX template to template.pptx before edits.
Uses markitdown output to inspect slide text and structure.
Explains how to reorder, delete, and duplicate slides through presentation XML and add_slide.py.
Provides XML text formatting rules for bold labels, bullets, smart quotes, and preserved whitespace.
Describes cleanup and repack steps for orphaned files, relationships, and media.
Advises parallel slide XML editing after structural changes are complete.
limitations: It is documentation only; helper scripts are referenced but not included in this package.
It assumes the user supplies an existing PPTX template.
It cannot verify visual layout without opening or rendering the final presentation.
Manual XML edits can still break a deck if relationships or namespaces are wrong.

use_cases.title: Refresh Client Presentations
use_cases.description: Update a branded PowerPoint template with new business content while preserving approved layouts.

use_cases.title: Adapt Campaign Decks
use_cases.description: Reuse an existing marketing deck, swap messages, remove unused slides, and keep visual variety.

use_cases.title: Convert Training Outlines
use_cases.description: Map structured training content into an existing slide template with clean bullets and section flow.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Template Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ppt-editing-skill to update my supplied PPTX with this content. Preserve the template style and create edited.pptx.

prompt_templates.title: Map Content to Layouts
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the template.md output and map each content section to varied slide layouts. Show the slide plan before XML edits.

prompt_templates.title: Rebuild Slide Order
prompt_templates.prompt: Delete unused slides, duplicate needed layouts, and reorder the deck. Complete structure changes before editing slide text.

prompt_templates.title: Perform XML-Safe Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: After replacing text and images, run cleanup and repack validation. Report orphaned assets, relationship fixes, and content QA results.

output_examples.input: A user provides a branded sales template and a new quarterly update.
output_examples.output: The skill produces an edited.pptx plan with selected layouts, updated slide text, cleaned unused assets, and validation notes.

output_examples.input: A team has a long outline that must fit an existing training deck.
output_examples.output: The skill maps sections to varied slide layouts, splits dense lists, and preserves template formatting rules.

best_practices: Complete slide deletes, duplicates, and ordering before changing text.
Use varied layouts so the final deck does not repeat one dense slide style.
Validate content with extracted text after edits, then inspect the final presentation visually.
anti_patterns: Editing the original PPTX instead of working on a copy.
Concatenating multiple list items into one paragraph inside a slide.
Clearing unused placeholders while leaving orphaned shapes or media.

faq.question: Does this skill create presentations from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for editing an existing PowerPoint file or template.

faq.question: Does it include helper scripts?
faq.answer: The reviewed package lists only SKILL.md. It references helper scripts but does not include them.

faq.question: Can it preserve formatting?
faq.answer: It gives XML rules for bullets, bold labels, smart quotes, and whitespace to preserve template styling.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive decks?
faq.answer: Use local files only and avoid unnecessary copies. Review temporary file handling before processing confidential presentations.

faq.question: Does it validate the final PPTX?
faq.answer: It describes cleanup, repacking, markitdown checks, and final edited.pptx output validation.
